guarantee.title: Anti-Penalty "Pay the Difference" Spend Guarantee
guarantee.description: Every single dollar or pound spent on modular add-ons (like an extra VIN unlock or coding module) is 100% credited toward upgrading to a higher lifetime tier. You never pay twice and you are never penalized for starting small.

tiers.name: Driver
tiers.tagline: For the weekend Porsche owner checking codes and monitoring car health.
features: 1 Vehicle VIN included with full diagnostic history
Complete multi-module DTC scanning (DME, Kombi, ABS/PSM, Alarm, Airbag, Climate)
Read and safe clear fault memory (verified 14 FF 00 safe protocol)
Curated real-time live sensor gauges (coolant, voltage, RPM, lambda)
Safe pre-clear freeze-frame snapshot reports
Full Multi-Platform Virtual Simulator (986, 996, 987, 997, Cayenne E1)
Dual-language English & authentic German engineering terminology

tiers.name: Enthusiast
tiers.tagline: For the hands-on owner maintaining multiple Porsches or doing custom retrofits.
features: Up to 5 Vehicle VINs in your personal garage
Everything in Driver Tier included
Used Donor Cluster Migration Wizard (VIN pairing & DME sync)
Speedometer Recalibration (In Beta: K-Zahl impulse table adjustment)
Future access to Coolant Gauge Linearization (In Development)
Kombi configuration & comfort coding backup and restore
High-resolution CSV telemetry logging & freeze-frame inspection
Structured PDF pre-purchase inspection (PPI) health dossiers

tiers.name: Tuner / Specialist
tiers.tagline: For track-day drivers, YouTubers, independent specialists, and tuners.
features: Unlimited Vehicle VINs across all supported platforms
Everything in Enthusiast Tier included
High-speed RAM variable live telemetry stream
Full ECU ROM & ST 95040 SPI EEPROM memory extraction (0x23)
Early access to beta vehicle protocols (987/997 CAN, Cayenne E1)
Multi-Module tamper audit & over-rev operating hours forensics
Exportable clean UI mode for video creators & track-day logging
Direct maintainer priority support channel
